name: scheduled-chat-continuation-gate
principle: A local job failure is not a run stop condition. Preserve the affected job/result, classify the failure, then continue with the next independent ready job whenever possible.

probe_success.action: preserve affected payload, skip only affected write path/job, continue independent work; later GitHub writes may still be attempted

probe_failure.action: disable further GitHub writes for the remainder of this run, preserve completed payloads via Google Drive outbox temporary transport, continue read/research/audit work that can be durably checkpointed

end_of_run_gate.rule: Before emitting a final response or ending voluntarily, evaluate stop_run_only_if. If none is true and independent work exists, the worker MUST continue instead of reporting the problem and stopping.
